newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Two Israeli soldiers killed in Lebanon attack.
newsitem.headline: Two Israeli soldiers killed in Lebanon attack.

text.p: Two Israeli soldiers were killed and two seriously wounded on Tuesday in a Lebanese guerrilla bomb attack in Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone, the Israeli army said.
"Two Israeli soliders were killed and two soldiers were wounded seriously by a roadside bomb that activated against an Israeli army force in the south Lebanon security zone," it said in a communique.
The pro-Iranian Hizbollah guerrilla movement claimed responsibility for the attack which pro-Israeli militia sources had said claimed the life of one soldier and seriously wounded three.
The sources said the blast occurred as Israeli soldiers were travelling on foot on the road between Marqaba and Odeissi deep in the central sector of the zone.
Tuesday's casualties brought to 27 the number of Israeli soldiers killed in south Lebanon so far this year, four more than last year's total.
Hizbollah (Party of God) leads an Islamic Resistance committed to ousting Israeli troops from the 15-km (nine-mile) south Lebanon border area.
